easy.q: A plant cell makes sugar using light. Which structure does this job?
Which difference between plant and animal cells is described in the notes?
choices: Plant cells have a supporting cell wall, unlike animal cells.
Animal cells use chloroplasts to capture light.

easy.q: How do chloroplasts and mitochondria each help a plant cell with energy?
easy.rubric: Award 2 marks: 1 for chloroplasts using light to make sugar; 1 for mitochondria releasing energy from food. Accept equivalent wording.
